paper_metadata.title: Compositional design of strong and ductile (tensile) Ti-Zr-Nb-Ta medium entropy alloys (MEAs) using the atomic mismatch approach

evidence.quote: New non-equiatomic Ti(25+x)-Zr25-Nb25-Ta(25-x) (x=0, 5, 10, 15, 20, in at%) medium entropy alloys (MEAs) have been designed using the atomic mismatch approach and fabricated through a conventional arc-melting process.
new non-equiatomic Ti(25+x)-Zr25-Nb25-Ta(25-x) (x=0, 5, 10, 15, 20, in at%) MEAs are designed, fabricated, and characterised.
